items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: she hired Freddie Johnson, she hired me... his name was Nelson Kincaide.

ctx.x: Yes, Cole Porter. He would be there in the Spring, from the Spring, say around May, until the end of September or October. He would be there every night. And she opened, she had Freddie Johnson to form an orchestra, she hired Freddie Johnson, she hired me, all individually, and her husband, Peter du Conge, she hired a very fine saxophone player, who was with the Buffalos, his name was Nelson Kincaide.
